sloka: कच्चित्क्षेमं तु देवर्षे कच्चिद्धर्मो न नश्यति ।किमागमनकृत्यं ते देवगन्धर्वसेवित ।। ७.२१.४ ॥
transliteration: kaccitkṣemaṁ tu devarṣe kacciddharmo na naśyati ।kimāgamanakṛtyaṁ te devagandharvasevita ।। 7.21.4 ॥

translations.english: Yama asked, "O divine sage, is all well with you, and is dharma not perishing? What is the purpose of your visit, O one revered by gods and gandharvas?"
